regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Telluride leads with 17" over six days, 10" of it Sunday. A Winter Storm Warning runs Sunday through Monday, with an avalanche advisory from Saturday night to Monday. Crested Butte is at 4", Aspen Highlands at 4".

regions.title: Southern Rockies
regions.text: Wolf Creek leads with 8", 6" of it Sunday, with strong southwest wind and gusts to 50 mph Sunday night. The NWS is calling for more, 8" to 17" over Sunday through Wednesday. Taos is at 6".
